The '''Gree Baaker Labor Camp''' was a prison camp of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The prisoners were later sent to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] to work, and all were killed in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Notable prisoners included the wife and son of Commander [[Rezi Soresh]], [[Ilaani Soresh]] and [[Kimali Soresh]].
